title: Lattice
description: JSON Schema for a lattice as data: a finite carrier set together with two binary operation tables interpreting the signature ⟨∧, ∨⟩. The signature and shape are captured here; the equational axioms (commutativity, associativity, idempotence, absorption) must be checked by a verifier and are out of scope for JSON Schema.

carrier.description: The underlying set L as a finite array of distinct symbolic values.

meet.description: The binary operation ∧ : L × L → L as a nested table; meet[a][b] is a ∧ b.

join.description: The binary operation ∨ : L × L → L as a nested table; join[a][b] is a ∨ b.

bottom.description: The least element ⊥ ∈ L, when the lattice is bounded. Optional; absence indicates the lattice is not bounded below.

top.description: The greatest element ⊤ ∈ L, when the lattice is bounded. Optional; absence indicates the lattice is not bounded above.

distributive.description: True when the lattice satisfies the distributive laws. Stored as a structural cell; not checked from the meet/join tables here.

binaryOperation.description: A binary operation on the carrier, represented as a table indexed by carrier element. Each carrier element appears once as a top-level key; its value is an object mapping carrier elements to the operation's result.
